name: User Journey Mapping
deliverable: End-to-end temporal visualization of user touchpoints and pain points

steps.text: Agree persona, goal, start, and end first.
Lay out stages in time order as columns, naming each from the user's point of view.
Mark pain points and drop-offs, then circle the two transitions this team should fix first.

failure: The map lists internal process steps in company language, documenting the organization, not the user.
intervention: Ask what the user would say they were doing; if it is an internal handoff, rewrite the visible user moment.
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.note: A standard service design and UX method; no single documented originator.
